texts.gal.2.4: а вкравшимся лжебратиям, скрытно приходившим подсмотреть за нашею свободою, которую мы имеем во Христе Иисусе, чтобы поработить нас,
texts.gal.2.5: мы ни на час не уступили и не покорились, дабы истина благовествования сохранилась у вас.
texts.gal.2.6: И в знаменитых чем-либо, какими бы ни были они когда-либо, для меня нет ничего особенного: Бог не взирает на лице человека. И знаменитые не возложили на меня ничего более.
texts.gal.2.7: Напротив того, увидев, что мне вверено благовестие для необрезанных, как Петру для обрезанных
texts.gal.2.8: [ибо Содействовавший Петру в апостольстве у обрезанных содействовал и мне у язычников],
texts.gal.2.9: и, узнав о благодати, данной мне, Иаков и Кифа и Иоанн, почитаемые столпами, подали мне и Варнаве руку общения, чтобы нам идти к язычникам, а им к обрезанным,
texts.gal.2.10: только чтобы мы помнили нищих, что и старался я исполнять в точности.
texts.gal.2.11: Когда же Петр пришел в Антиохию, то я лично противостал ему, потому что он подвергался нареканию.
texts.gal.2.12: Ибо, до прибытия некоторых от Иакова, ел вместе с язычниками; а когда те пришли, стал таиться и устраняться, опасаясь обрезанных.
texts.gal.2.13: Вместе с ним лицемерили и прочие Иудеи, так что даже Варнава был увлечен их лицемерием.
texts.gal.2.14: Но когда я увидел, что они не прямо поступают по истине Евангельской, то сказал Петру при всех: если ты, будучи Иудеем, живешь по-язычески, а не по-иудейски, то для чего язычников принуждаешь жить по-иудейски?
texts.gal.2.15: Мы по природе Иудеи, а не из язычников грешники;
texts.gal.2.16: однако же, узнав, что человек оправдывается не делами закона, а только верою в Иисуса Христа, и мы уверовали во Христа Иисуса, чтобы оправдаться верою во Христа, а не делами закона; ибо делами закона не оправдается никакая плоть.
texts.gal.2.17: Если же, ища оправдания во Христе, мы и сами оказались грешниками, то неужели Христос есть служитель греха? Никак.
texts.gal.2.18: Ибо если я снова созидаю, что разрушил, то сам себя делаю преступником.
texts.gal.2.19: Законом я умер для закона, чтобы жить для Бога. Я сораспялся Христу,
texts.gal.2.20: и уже не я живу, но живет во мне Христос. А что ныне живу во плоти, то живу верою в Сына Божия, возлюбившего меня и предавшего Себя за меня.
texts.gal.2.21: Не отвергаю благодати Божией; а если законом оправдание, то Христос напрасно умер.
texts.gal.3.1: О, несмысленные Галаты! кто прельстил вас не покоряться истине, вас, у которых перед глазами предначертан был Иисус Христос, как бы у вас распятый?
texts.gal.3.2: Сие только хочу знать от вас: через дела ли закона вы получили Духа, или через наставление в вере?
texts.gal.3.3: Так ли вы несмысленны, что, начав духом, теперь оканчиваете плотью?
texts.gal.3.4: Столь многое потерпели вы неужели без пользы? О, если бы только без пользы!
texts.gal.3.5: Подающий вам Духа и совершающий между вами чудеса через дела ли закона сие производит, или через наставление в вере?
texts.gal.3.6: Так Авраам поверил Богу, и это вменилось ему в праведность.
texts.gal.3.7: Познайте же, что верующие суть сыны Авраама.
texts.gal.3.8: И Писание, провидя, что Бог верою оправдает язычников, предвозвестило Аврааму: в тебе благословятся все народы.
texts.gal.3.9: Итак верующие благословляются с верным Авраамом,
texts.gal.3.10: а все, утверждающиеся на делах закона, находятся под клятвою. Ибо написано: проклят всяк, кто не исполняет постоянно всего, что написано в книге закона.
texts.gal.3.11: А что законом никто не оправдывается пред Богом, это ясно, потому что праведный верою жив будет.
texts.gal.3.12: А закон не по вере; но кто исполняет его, тот жив будет им.
texts.gal.3.13: Христос искупил нас от клятвы закона, сделавшись за нас клятвою [ибо написано: проклят всяк, висящий на древе],
texts.gal.3.14: дабы благословение Авраамово через Христа Иисуса распространилось на язычников, чтобы нам получить обещанного Духа верою.
texts.gal.3.15: Братия! говорю по рассуждению человеческому: даже человеком утвержденного завещания никто не отменяет и не прибавляет к нему.
texts.gal.3.16: Но Аврааму даны были обетования и семени его. Не сказано: и потомкам, как бы о многих, но как об одном: и семени твоему, которое есть Христос.
texts.gal.3.17: Я говорю то, что завета о Христе, прежде Богом утвержденного, закон, явившийся спустя четыреста тридцать лет, не отменяет так, чтобы обетование потеряло силу.
texts.gal.3.18: Ибо если по закону наследство, то уже не по обетованию; но Аврааму Бог даровал оное по обетованию.
texts.gal.3.19: Для чего же закон? Он дан после по причине преступлений, до времени пришествия семени, к которому относится обетование, и преподан через Ангелов, рукою посредника.
texts.gal.3.20: Но посредник при одном не бывает, а Бог один.
texts.gal.3.21: Итак закон противен обетованиям Божиим? Никак! Ибо если бы дан был закон, могущий животворить, то подлинно праведность была бы от закона;
texts.gal.3.22: но Писание всех заключило под грехом, дабы обетование верующим дано было по вере в Иисуса Христа.
texts.gal.3.23: А до пришествия веры мы заключены были под стражею закона, до того времени, как надлежало открыться вере.
texts.gal.3.24: Итак закон был для нас детоводителем ко Христу, дабы нам оправдаться верою;
texts.gal.3.25: по пришествии же веры, мы уже не под руководством детоводителя.
texts.gal.3.26: Ибо все вы сыны Божии по вере во Христа Иисуса;
texts.gal.3.27: все вы, во Христа крестившиеся, во Христа облеклись.
texts.gal.3.28: Нет уже Иудея, ни язычника; нет раба, ни свободного; нет мужеского пола, ни женского: ибо все вы одно во Христе Иисусе.
texts.gal.3.29: Если же вы Христовы, то вы семя Авраамово и по обетованию наследники.
texts.gal.4.1: Еще скажу: наследник, доколе в детстве, ничем не отличается от раба, хотя и господин всего:
texts.gal.4.2: он подчинен попечителям и домоправителям до срока, отцом назначенного.
texts.gal.4.3: Так и мы, доколе были в детстве, были порабощены вещественным началам мира;
texts.gal.4.4: но когда пришла полнота времени, Бог послал Сына Своего [Единородного], Который родился от жены, подчинился закону,
texts.gal.4.5: чтобы искупить подзаконных, дабы нам получить усыновление.
texts.gal.4.6: А как вы — сыны, то Бог послал в сердца ваши Духа Сына Своего, вопиющего: "Авва, Отче!"
texts.gal.4.7: Посему ты уже не раб, но сын; а если сын, то и наследник Божий через Иисуса Христа.
texts.gal.4.8: Но тогда, не знав Бога, вы служили богам, которые в существе не боги.
texts.gal.4.9: Ныне же, познав Бога, или, лучше, получив познание от Бога, для чего возвращаетесь опять к немощным и бедным вещественным началам и хотите еще снова поработить себя им?
texts.gal.4.10: Наблюдаете дни, месяцы, времена и годы.
texts.gal.4.11: Боюсь за вас, не напрасно ли я трудился у вас.
texts.gal.4.12: Прошу вас, братия, будьте, как я, потому что и я, как вы. Вы ничем не обидели меня:
texts.gal.4.13: знаете, что, хотя я в немощи плоти благовествовал вам в первый раз,
texts.gal.4.14: но вы не презрели искушения моего во плоти моей и не возгнушались им, а приняли меня, как Ангела Божия, как Христа Иисуса.
texts.gal.4.15: Как вы были блаженны! Свидетельствую о вас, что, если бы возможно было, вы исторгли бы очи свои и отдали мне.
texts.gal.4.16: Итак, неужели я сделался врагом вашим, говоря вам истину?
texts.gal.4.17: Ревнуют по вас нечисто, а хотят вас отлучить, чтобы вы ревновали по них.
texts.gal.4.18: Хорошо ревновать в добром всегда, а не в моем только присутствии у вас.
texts.gal.4.19: Дети мои, для которых я снова в муках рождения, доколе не изобразится в вас Христос!
texts.gal.4.20: Хотел бы я теперь быть у вас и изменить голос мой, потому что я в недоумении о вас.
texts.gal.4.21: Скажите мне вы, желающие быть под законом: разве вы не слушаете закона?
texts.gal.4.22: Ибо написано: Авраам имел двух сынов, одного от рабы, а другого от свободной.
texts.gal.4.23: Но который от рабы, тот рожден по плоти; а который от свободной, тот по обетованию.
texts.gal.4.24: В этом есть иносказание. Это два завета: один от горы Синайской, рождающий в рабство, который есть Агарь,
texts.gal.4.25: ибо Агарь означает гору Синай в Аравии и соответствует нынешнему Иерусалиму, потому что он с детьми своими в рабстве;
texts.gal.4.26: а вышний Иерусалим свободен: он — матерь всем нам.
texts.gal.4.27: Ибо написано: возвеселись, неплодная, нерождающая; воскликни и возгласи, не мучившаяся родами; потому что у оставленной гораздо более детей, нежели у имеющей мужа.
texts.gal.4.28: Мы, братия, дети обетования по Исааку.
texts.gal.4.29: Но, как тогда рожденный по плоти гнал рожденного по духу, так и ныне.
texts.gal.4.30: Что же говорит Писание? Изгони рабу и сына ее, ибо сын рабы не будет наследником вместе с сыном свободной.
texts.gal.4.31: Итак, братия, мы дети не рабы, но свободной.
texts.gal.5.1: Итак стойте в свободе, которую даровал нам Христос, и не подвергайтесь опять игу рабства.
texts.gal.5.2: Вот, я, Павел, говорю вам: если вы обрезываетесь, не будет вам никакой пользы от Христа.
texts.gal.5.3: Еще свидетельствую всякому человеку обрезывающемуся, что он должен исполнить весь закон.
texts.gal.5.4: Вы, оправдывающие себя законом, остались без Христа, отпали от благодати,
texts.gal.5.5: а мы духом ожидаем и надеемся праведности от веры.
texts.gal.5.6: Ибо во Христе Иисусе не имеет силы ни обрезание, ни необрезание, но вера, действующая любовью.
texts.gal.5.7: Вы шли хорошо: кто остановил вас, чтобы вы не покорялись истине?
texts.gal.5.8: Такое убеждение не от Призывающего вас.
texts.gal.5.10: Я уверен о вас в Господе, что вы не будете мыслить иначе; а смущающий вас, кто бы он ни был, понесет на себе осуждение.
texts.gal.5.11: За что же гонят меня, братия, если я и теперь проповедую обрезание? Тогда соблазн креста прекратился бы.
texts.gal.5.12: О, если бы удалены были возмущающие вас!
texts.gal.5.13: К свободе призваны вы, братия, только бы свобода ваша не была поводом к угождению плоти, но любовью служите друг другу.
texts.gal.5.14: Ибо весь закон в одном слове заключается: люби ближнего твоего, как самого себя.
texts.gal.5.15: Если же друг друга угрызаете и съедаете, берегитесь, чтобы вы не были истреблены друг другом.
texts.gal.5.16: Я говорю: поступайте по духу, и вы не будете исполнять вожделений плоти,
texts.gal.5.17: ибо плоть желает противного духу, а дух — противного плоти: они друг другу противятся, так что вы не то делаете, что хотели бы.
texts.gal.5.18: Если же вы духом водитесь, то вы не под законом.
texts.gal.5.19: Дела плоти известны; они суть: прелюбодеяние, блуд, нечистота, непотребство,
texts.gal.5.20: идолослужение, волшебство, вражда, ссоры, зависть, гнев, распри, разногласия, [соблазны,] ереси,
texts.gal.5.21: ненависть, убийства, пьянство, бесчинство и тому подобное. Предваряю вас, как и прежде предварял, что поступающие так Царствия Божия не наследуют.
texts.gal.5.22: Плод же духа: любовь, радость, мир, долготерпение, благость, милосердие, вера,
texts.gal.5.23: кротость, воздержание. На таковых нет закона.
texts.gal.5.24: Но те, которые Христовы, распяли плоть со страстями и похотями.
texts.gal.5.25: Если мы живем духом, то по духу и поступать должны.
texts.gal.5.26: Не будем тщеславиться, друг друга раздражать, друг другу завидовать.
texts.gal.6.1: Братия! если и впадет человек в какое согрешение, вы, духовные, исправляйте такового в духе кротости, наблюдая каждый за собою, чтобы не быть искушенным.
texts.gal.6.2: Носите бремена друг друга, и таким образом исполните закон Христов.
texts.gal.6.3: Ибо кто почитает себя чем-нибудь, будучи ничто, тот обольщает сам себя.
texts.gal.6.4: Каждый да испытывает свое дело, и тогда будет иметь похвалу только в себе, а не в другом,
texts.gal.6.6: Наставляемый словом, делись всяким добром с наставляющим.
texts.gal.6.7: Не обманывайтесь: Бог поругаем не бывает. Что посеет человек, то и пожнет:
texts.gal.6.8: сеющий в плоть свою от плоти пожнет тление, а сеющий в дух от духа пожнет жизнь вечную.
texts.gal.6.9: Делая добро, да не унываем, ибо в свое время пожнем, если не ослабеем.
texts.gal.6.10: Итак, доколе есть время, будем делать добро всем, а наипаче своим по вере.
texts.gal.6.11: Видите, как много написал я вам своею рукою.
texts.gal.6.12: Желающие хвалиться по плоти принуждают вас обрезываться только для того, чтобы не быть гонимыми за крест Христов,
texts.gal.6.13: ибо и сами обрезывающиеся не соблюдают закона, но хотят, чтобы вы обрезывались, дабы похвалиться в вашей плоти.
texts.gal.6.14: А я не желаю хвалиться, разве только крестом Господа нашего Иисуса Христа, которым для меня мир распят, и я для мира.
texts.gal.6.15: Ибо во Христе Иисусе ничего не значит ни обрезание, ни необрезание, а новая тварь.
texts.gal.6.16: Тем, которые поступают по сему правилу, мир им и милость, и Израилю Божию.
texts.gal.6.17: Впрочем никто не отягощай меня, ибо я ношу язвы Господа Иисуса на теле моем.
texts.gal.6.18: Благодать Господа нашего Иисуса Христа со духом вашим, братия. Аминь.

texts.gal.1.1: Paulo apostolo (não da parte dos homens, nem por homem algum, mas por Jesus Christo, e por Deus Pae, que o resuscitou dos mortos)
texts.gal.1.2: E todos os irmãos que estão comigo, ás egrejas da Galacia:
texts.gal.1.3: Graça e paz de Deus Pae e de nosso Senhor Jesus Christo,
texts.gal.1.4: O qual se deu a si mesmo por nossos peccados, para nos livrar do presente seculo mau, segundo a vontade de Deus nosso Pae.
texts.gal.1.5: Ao qual gloria para todo o sempre. Amen.
texts.gal.1.6: Maravilho-me de que tão depressa passasseis d’aquelle que vos chamou á graça de Christo para outro evangelho.
texts.gal.1.7: Que não é outro, mas ha alguns que vos inquietam e querem transtornar o evangelho de Christo.
texts.gal.1.8: Mas, ainda que nós mesmos, ou um anjo do céu vos annuncie outro evangelho, além do que já vos tenho annunciado, seja anathema.
texts.gal.1.9: Assim como já vol-o dissemos, agora de novo tambem vol-o digo. Se algum vos annunciar outro evangelho além do que já recebestes, seja anathema.
texts.gal.1.10: Porque, persuado eu agora a homens ou a Deus? ou procuro comprazer a homens? se comprazera ainda aos homens, não seria servo de Christo.
texts.gal.1.11: Mas faço-vos saber, irmãos, que o evangelho que por mim foi annunciado não é segundo os homens.
texts.gal.1.12: Porque não o recebi, nem aprendi de homem algum, mas pela revelação de Jesus Christo.
texts.gal.1.13: Porque já ouvistes qual foi antigamente a minha conducta no judaismo, que sobremaneira perseguia a egreja de Deus e a assolava.
texts.gal.1.14: E como na minha nação excedia em judaismo a muitos da minha edade, sendo extremamente zeloso das tradições de meus paes.
texts.gal.1.15: Mas, quando approuve a Deus, que desde o ventre de minha mãe me separou, e me chamou pela sua graça,
texts.gal.1.16: Revelar seu Filho em mim, para que o prégasse entre os gentios, não consultei a carne nem o sangue,
texts.gal.1.17: Nem tornei a Jerusalem, a ter com os que já antes de mim eram apostolos, mas parti para a Arabia, e voltei outra vez a Damasco.
texts.gal.1.18: Depois, passados tres annos, fui a Jerusalem para ver a Pedro, e fiquei com elle quinze dias.
texts.gal.1.19: E não vi a nenhum outro dos apostolos, senão a Thiago, irmão do Senhor.
texts.gal.1.20: Ora, ácerca das coisas que vos escrevo, eis que diante de Deus testifico que não minto.
texts.gal.1.21: Depois fui para as partes da Syria e da Cilicia.
texts.gal.1.22: E não era conhecido de vista das egrejas da Judea, que estavam em Christo;
texts.gal.1.23: Mas sómente tinham ouvido dizer: Aquelle que d’antes nos perseguia annuncia agora a fé que d’antes destruia.
texts.gal.1.24: E glorificavam a Deus a respeito de mim.
texts.gal.2.1: Depois, passados quatorze annos, subi outra vez a Jerusalem com Barnabé, levando tambem comigo Tito.
texts.gal.2.2: E subi por uma revelação, e lhes expuz o evangelho, que prégo entre os gentios, e particularmente aos que estavam em estima; para que de maneira alguma não corresse ou houvesse corrido em vão.
texts.gal.2.3: Porém nem ainda Tito, que estava comigo, sendo grego, foi constrangido a circumcidar-se;
texts.gal.2.4: E isto por causa dos falsos irmãos que se tinham entremettido, e secretamente entraram a espiar a nossa liberdade, que temos em Christo Jesus, para nos pôrem em servidão:
texts.gal.2.5: Aos quaes nem ainda por uma hora cedemos com sujeição, para que a verdade do evangelho permanecesse entre vós,
texts.gal.2.6: E, quanto áquelles que pareciam ser alguma coisa (quaes tenham sido n’outro tempo, não se me dá; Deus não acceita a apparencia do homem) esses, digo, que pareciam ser alguma coisa, nada me communicaram;
texts.gal.2.7: Antes, pelo contrario, quando viram que o evangelho da incircumcisão me estava confiado, como a Pedro o da circumcisão
texts.gal.2.8: (Porque aquelle que operou efficazmente em Pedro para o apostolado da circumcisão esse operou tambem em mim com efficacia para com os gentios),
texts.gal.2.9: E conhecendo Thiago, Cephas e João, que eram considerados como as columnas, a graça que se me havia dado, deram as dextras de parceria comigo, e a Barnabé, para que nós fossemos aos gentios, e elles á circumcisão;
texts.gal.2.10: Recommendando-nos sómente que nos lembrassemos dos pobres: o que tambem procurei fazer com diligencia.
texts.gal.2.11: E, chegando Pedro a Antiochia, lhe resisti na cara, porque era reprehensivel.
texts.gal.2.12: Porque, antes que alguns tivessem chegado da parte de Thiago, comia com os gentios; mas, depois que chegaram, se retirou, e se apartou d’elles, temendo aos que eram da circumcisão.
texts.gal.2.13: E os outros judeos consentiam tambem na sua dissimulação, de maneira que até Barnabé se deixou levar pela sua dissimulação.
texts.gal.2.14: Mas, quando vi que não andavam bem e direitamente conforme a verdade do evangelho, disse a Pedro na presença de todos: Se tu, sendo judeo, vives como os gentios, e não como judeo, porque obrigas os gentios a viverem como judeos?
texts.gal.2.15: Nós somos judeos por natureza e não peccadores d’entre os gentios.
texts.gal.2.16: Sabendo que o homem não é justificado pelas obras da lei, mas pela fé de Jesus Christo, havemos tambem crido em Jesus Christo, para sermos justificados pela fé de Christo, e não pelas obras da lei; porquanto pelas obras da lei nenhuma carne será justificada.
texts.gal.2.17: Pois, se nós que procuramos ser justificados em Christo, nós mesmos tambem somos achados peccadores, é porventura Christo ministro do peccado? De maneira nenhuma.
texts.gal.2.18: Porque, se torno a vivificar as coisas que já destrui, constituo-me a mim mesmo transgressor.
texts.gal.2.19: Porque eu pela lei estou morto para a lei, para viver para Deus.
texts.gal.2.20: Já estou crucificado com Christo; e vivo, não mais eu, mas Christo vive em mim; e a vida que agora vivo na carne vivo a na fé do Filho de Deus, o qual me amou, e se entregou a si mesmo por mim.
texts.gal.2.21: Não aniquilo a graça de Deus; porque, se a justiça provém da lei, segue-se que Christo morreu debalde.
texts.gal.3.1: Ó insensatos galatas! quem vos fascinou para não obedecerdes á verdade,—vós, perante os olhos de quem Jesus Christo foi já representado, como crucificado entre vós?
texts.gal.3.2: Só quizera saber isto de vós: recebestes o Espirito pelas obras da lei ou pela prégação da fé?
texts.gal.3.3: Sois vós tão insensatos que, tendo começado pelo Espirito, acabeis agora pela carne?
texts.gal.3.4: Será em vão que tenhaes padecido tanto? Se é que tambem foi em vão.
texts.gal.3.5: Aquelle pois que vos dá o Espirito, e que obra maravilhas entre vós, fal-o pelas obras da lei, ou pela prégação da fé?
texts.gal.3.6: Assim como Abrahão creu em Deus, e isso lhe foi imputado como justiça.
texts.gal.3.7: Sabei pois que os que são da fé são filhos de Abrahão.
texts.gal.3.8: Ora, tendo a Escriptura previsto que Deus havia de justificar pela fé os gentios, annunciou primeiro o evangelho a Abrahão, dizendo: Todas as nações serão bemditas em ti.
texts.gal.3.9: De sorte que os que são da fé são bemditos com o crente Abrahão.
texts.gal.3.10: Todos aquelles pois que são das obras da lei estão debaixo da maldição; porque escripto está: Maldito todo aquelle que não permanecer em todas as coisas que estão escriptas no livro da lei, para fazel-as.
texts.gal.3.11: E é evidente que pela lei ninguem será justificado diante de Deus, porque o justo viverá pela fé.
texts.gal.3.12: Ora a lei não é da fé; mas o homem que fizer estas coisas por ellas viverá.
texts.gal.3.13: Christo nos resgatou da maldição da lei, fazendo-se maldição por nós; porque está escripto: Maldito todo aquelle que fôr pendurado no madeiro;
texts.gal.3.14: Para que a benção de Abrahão chegasse aos gentios por Jesus Christo, e para que pela fé nós recebamos a promessa do Espirito.
texts.gal.3.15: Irmãos, como homem fallo; se o concerto de um homem fôr confirmado, ninguem o annulla nem lhe accrescenta.
texts.gal.3.16: Ora as promessas foram feitas a Abrahão e á sua posteridade. Não diz: E ás posteridades, como fallando de muitas, mas como de uma só: E á tua posteridade; a qual é Christo.
texts.gal.3.17: Mas digo isto: Que o concerto, anteriormente confirmado por Deus em Christo, a lei, que veiu quatrocentos e trinta annos depois, não invalida, de fórma a abolir a promessa.
texts.gal.3.18: Porque, se a herança provém da lei, logo não provém já da promessa: porém Deus pela promessa a deu gratuitamente a Abrahão.
texts.gal.3.19: Logo, para que é a lei? Foi ordenada por causa das transgressões, até que viesse a posteridade a quem a promessa tinha sido feita; e foi posta pelos anjos na mão de um medianeiro.
texts.gal.3.20: Ora o medianeiro não é de um, mas Deus é um.
texts.gal.3.21: Logo, a lei é contra as promessas de Deus? De nenhuma sorte; porque, se dada fosse uma lei que podesse vivificar, a justiça, na verdade, seria pela lei.
texts.gal.3.22: Mas a Escriptura encerrou tudo debaixo do peccado, para que a promessa pela fé em Jesus Christo fosse dada aos crentes.
texts.gal.3.23: Porém, antes que a fé viesse, estavamos guardados debaixo da lei, e encerrados para aquella fé que se havia de manifestar.
texts.gal.3.24: De maneira que a lei nos serviu de aio, para nos conduzir a Christo, para que pela fé fossemos justificados.
texts.gal.3.25: Mas, depois que a fé veiu, já não estamos debaixo de aio.
texts.gal.3.26: Porque todos sois filhos de Deus pela fé em Christo Jesus.
texts.gal.3.27: Porque todos quantos fostes baptizados em Christo já vos revestistes de Christo.
texts.gal.3.28: N’isto não ha judeo nem grego; não ha servo nem livre; não ha macho nem femea; porque todos vós sois um em Christo Jesus.
texts.gal.3.29: E, se sois de Christo, logo sois descendencia de Abrahão, e herdeiros conforme a promessa.
texts.gal.4.1: Digo, pois, que todo o tempo que o herdeiro é menino, em nada differe do servo, ainda que seja senhor de tudo;
texts.gal.4.2: Mas está debaixo dos tutores e curadores até ao tempo determinado pelo pae.
texts.gal.4.3: Assim tambem nós, quando eramos meninos, estavamos reduzidos á servidão debaixo dos primeiros rudimentos do mundo.
texts.gal.4.4: Mas, vindo a plenitude dos tempos, Deus enviou o seu Filho, nascido de mulher, nascido sob a lei,
texts.gal.4.5: Para remir os que estavam debaixo da lei, a fim de recebermos a adopção de filhos.
texts.gal.4.6: E, porque sois filhos, Deus enviou aos vossos corações o Espirito de seu Filho, que clama: Abba, Pae.
texts.gal.4.7: Assim que já não és mais servo, mas filho; e, se és filho, és tambem herdeiro de Deus por Christo.
texts.gal.4.8: Mas, quando não conhecieis Deus, servieis aos que por natureza não são deuses.
texts.gal.4.9: Porém agora, conhecendo Deus, ou, antes, sendo conhecidos de Deus, como tornaes outra vez a esses rudimentos fracos e pobres, aos quaes de novo quereis servir?
texts.gal.4.10: Guardaes dias, e mezes, e tempos, e annos.
texts.gal.4.11: Temo por vós, que não haja trabalhado em vão para comvosco.
texts.gal.4.12: Irmãos, rogo-vos, que sejaes como eu, porque tambem eu sou como vós: nenhum mal me fizestes.
texts.gal.4.13: E vós sabeis que primeiro vos annunciei o Evangelho com fraqueza da carne;
texts.gal.4.14: E não rejeitastes, nem desprezastes a tentação que tinha na minha carne, antes me recebestes como um anjo de Deus, como Jesus Christo mesmo.
texts.gal.4.15: Qual era logo a vossa bemaventurança? Porque vos dou testemunho de que, se possivel fôra, arrancarieis os vossos olhos, e m’os darieis.
texts.gal.4.16: Fiz-me acaso vosso inimigo, dizendo a verdade?
texts.gal.4.17: Teem zelo por vós, não como convém; mas querem excluir-vos, para que vós tenhaes zelo por elles.
texts.gal.4.18: É bom ser zeloso, mas sempre do bem, e não sómente quando estou presente comvosco.
texts.gal.4.19: Meus filhinhos, por quem de novo sinto as dôres de parto, até que Christo seja formado em vós:
texts.gal.4.20: Eu bem quizera agora estar presente comvosco, e mudar a minha voz; porque estou em duvida a vosso respeito.
texts.gal.4.21: Dizei-me, os que quereis estar debaixo da lei, não ouvis vós a lei?
texts.gal.4.22: Porque está escripto que Abrahão teve dois filhos, um da escrava, e outro da livre.
texts.gal.4.23: Mas o que era da escrava nasceu segundo a carne, porém o que era da livre por promessa.
texts.gal.4.24: O que se entende por allegoria; porque estes são os dois concertos; um, do monte Sinai, gerando para a servidão, que é Agar.
texts.gal.4.25: Ora Agar é Sinai, um monte da Arabia, e corresponde á Jerusalem que agora existe, que é escrava com seus filhos.
texts.gal.4.26: Mas a Jerusalem que é de cima é livre; a qual é mãe de todos nós.
texts.gal.4.27: Porque está escripto: Alegra-te, esteril, que não pares: esforça-te e clama, tu que não estás de parto; porque os filhos da solitaria são mais do que os da que tem marido.
texts.gal.4.28: Porém nós, irmãos, somos filhos da promessa como Isaac.
texts.gal.4.29: Mas, como então, aquelle que era gerado segundo a carne perseguia o que era gerado segundo o Espirito, assim é tambem agora.
texts.gal.4.30: Mas que diz a Escriptura? Lança fóra a escrava e seu filho, porque de modo algum o filho da escrava herdará com o filho da livre.
texts.gal.4.31: De maneira que, irmãos, somos filhos, não da escrava, mas da livre.
texts.gal.5.1: Estae pois firmes na liberdade com que Christo nos libertou, e não torneis a metter-vos debaixo do jugo da servidão.
texts.gal.5.2: Eis aqui, eu, Paulo, vos digo que, se vos deixardes circumcidar, Christo de nada vos aproveitará.
texts.gal.5.3: E de novo protesto a todo o homem que se deixa circumcidar que está obrigado a guardar a lei.
texts.gal.5.4: Separados estaes de Christo, vós os que vos justificaes pela lei: da graça tendes caido.
texts.gal.5.5: Porque pelo espirito da fé aguardamos a esperança da justiça.
texts.gal.5.6: Porque a circumcisão e a incircumcisão não teem virtude alguma em Christo Jesus; mas sim a fé que obra por caridade.
texts.gal.5.7: Corrieis bem; quem vos impediu, para que não obedeçaes á verdade?
texts.gal.5.8: Esta persuasão não vem d’aquelle que vos chamou.
texts.gal.5.9: Um pouco de fermento levéda toda a massa.
texts.gal.5.10: Confio de vós, no Senhor, que nenhuma outra coisa sentireis; mas aquelle que vos inquieta, seja elle quem quer que fôr, soffrerá a condemnação.
texts.gal.5.11: Eu, porém, irmãos, se prégo ainda a circumcisão, porque serei pois perseguido? logo o escandalo da cruz está anniquilado.
texts.gal.5.12: Oxalá que aquelles que vos andam inquietando fossem tambem cortados.
texts.gal.5.13: Porque vós, irmãos, fostes chamados á liberdade. Não useis da liberdade só para dar occasião á carne, porém servi-vos uns aos outros pela caridade.
texts.gal.5.14: Porque toda a lei se cumpre n’uma só palavra, n’esta: Amarás ao teu proximo como a ti mesmo.
texts.gal.5.15: Se vós, porém, vos mordeis e devoraes uns aos outros, vêde não vos consumaes tambem uns aos outros.
texts.gal.5.16: Digo, porém: Andae em Espirito, e não cumprireis a concupiscencia da carne.
texts.gal.5.17: Porque a carne cobiça contra o Espirito, e o Espirito contra a carne; e estes oppõem-se um ao outro: para que não façaes o que quereis.
texts.gal.5.18: Porém, se sois guiados pelo Espirito, não estaes debaixo da lei.
texts.gal.5.19: Porque as obras da carne são manifestas, as quaes são: Adulterio, fornicação, immundicia, dissolução,
texts.gal.5.20: Idolatria, feitiçarias, inimizades, porfias, emulações, iras, pelejas, dissensões, heresias,
texts.gal.5.21: Invejas, homicidios, bebedices, glotonerias, e coisas similhantes a estas, ácerca das quaes vos declaro, como já d’antes vos disse, que os que commettem taes coisas não herdarão o reino de Deus.
texts.gal.5.22: Mas o fructo do Espirito é caridade, gozo, paz, longanimidade, benignidade, bondade, fé, mansidão, temperança.
texts.gal.5.23: Contra estas coisas não ha lei.
texts.gal.5.24: Porém os que são de Christo crucificaram a carne com as suas paixões e concupiscencias.
texts.gal.5.25: Se vivemos em Espirito, andemos tambem em Espirito.
texts.gal.5.26: Não sejamos cubiçosos de vanglorias, irritando-nos uns aos outros, invejando-nos uns aos outros.
texts.gal.6.1: Irmãos, se algum homem chegar a ser surprehendido n’alguma offensa, vós, que sois espirituaes, encaminhae ao tal com espirito de mansidão; olhando por ti mesmo, para que não sejas tambem tentado.
texts.gal.6.2: Levae as cargas um dos outros, e assim cumprireis a lei de Christo.
texts.gal.6.3: Porque, se alguem cuida ser alguma coisa, não sendo nada, engana-se a si mesmo.
texts.gal.6.4: Mas prove cada um a sua propria obra, e terá gloria só em si mesmo, e não n’outro.
texts.gal.6.5: Porque cada qual levará a sua propria carga.
texts.gal.6.6: E o que é instruido na palavra reparta de todos os seus bens com aquelle que o instrue.
texts.gal.6.7: Não erreis: Deus não se deixa escarnecer; porque tudo o que o homem semear, isso tambem ceifará.
texts.gal.6.8: Porque o que semeia na sua carne, da carne ceifará a corrupção; mas o que semeia no Espirito, do Espirito ceifará a vida eterna.
texts.gal.6.9: E não nos cancemos de fazer bem, porque a seu tempo ceifaremos, se não houvermos desfallecido.
texts.gal.6.10: De sorte que, emquanto temos tempo, façamos bem a todos, mas principalmente aos domesticos da fé.
texts.gal.6.11: Vêde com que grandes lettras vos escrevi por minha mão.
texts.gal.6.12: Todos os que querem mostrar boa apparencia na carne esses vos obrigam a circumcidar-vos, sómente para não serem perseguidos por causa da cruz de Christo.
texts.gal.6.13: Porque nem ainda esses mesmos que se circumcidam guardam a lei, mas querem que vos circumcideis, para se gloriarem na vossa carne.
texts.gal.6.14: Mas longe esteja de mim gloriar-me, a não ser na cruz de nosso Senhor Jesus Christo, por quem o mundo está crucificado para mim e eu para o mundo.
texts.gal.6.15: Porque em Christo Jesus nem a circumcisão nem a incircumcisão tem virtude alguma, mas sim o ser uma nova creatura.
texts.gal.6.16: E a todos quantos andarem conforme esta regra, paz e misericordia sobre elles e sobre o Israel de Deus.
texts.gal.6.17: Quanto ao mais, ninguem me seja molesto; porque trago no meu corpo as marcas do Senhor Jesus.
texts.gal.6.18: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Christo seja, irmãos, com o vosso espirito. Amen.

texts.gal.1.1: Paul, an apostle, (not from men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
texts.gal.1.2: And all the brethren who are with me, to the churches of Galatia:
texts.gal.1.3: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
texts.gal.1.4: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
texts.gal.1.5: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
texts.gal.1.6: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ, to another gospel:
texts.gal.1.7: Which is not another; but there are some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
texts.gal.1.8: But though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach any other gospel to you than that which we have preached to you, let him be accursed.
texts.gal.1.9: As we said before, so I say now again, If any man preacheth any other gospel to you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
texts.gal.1.10: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
texts.gal.1.11: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached by me is not according to man.
texts.gal.1.12: For I neither received it from man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
texts.gal.1.13: For ye have heard of my manner of life in time past in the Jews' religion, that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it;
texts.gal.1.14: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in my own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
texts.gal.1.15: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
texts.gal.1.16: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
texts.gal.1.17: Neither did I go to Jerusalem to them who were apostles before me: but I went into Arabia, and returned again to Damascus.
texts.gal.1.18: Then after three years I went to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
texts.gal.1.19: But I saw no other of the apostles, save James the Lord's brother.
texts.gal.1.20: Now the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I lie not.
texts.gal.1.21: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
texts.gal.1.22: And was unknown by face to the churches of Judea which were in Christ:
texts.gal.1.23: But they had heard only, That he who persecuted us in times past, now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
texts.gal.1.24: And they glorified God in me.
texts.gal.2.1: Then fourteen years after I went again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
texts.gal.2.2: And I went by revelation, and communicated to them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them who were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run in vain.
texts.gal.2.3: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
texts.gal.2.4: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privately to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
texts.gal.2.5: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
texts.gal.2.6: But of these, who seemed to be somewhat, (whatever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat, in conference added nothing to me:
texts.gal.2.7: But on the contrary, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed to me, as the gospel of the circumcision was to Peter;
texts.gal.2.8: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me towards the Gentiles:)
texts.gal.2.9: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given to me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go to the heathen, and they to the circumcision.
texts.gal.2.10: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
texts.gal.2.11: But when Peter had come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
texts.gal.2.12: For before that certain came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles: but when they had come, he withdrew, and separated himself, fearing them who were of the circumcision.
texts.gal.2.13: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; so that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
texts.gal.2.14: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said to Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
texts.gal.2.15: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
texts.gal.2.16: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we may be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
texts.gal.2.17: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? By no means.
texts.gal.2.18: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
texts.gal.2.19: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I may live to God.
texts.gal.2.20: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless, I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh, I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
texts.gal.2.21: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness is attainable by the law, then Christ hath died in vain.
texts.gal.3.1: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
texts.gal.3.2: This only would I learn from you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
texts.gal.3.3: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
texts.gal.3.4: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it is yet in vain.
texts.gal.3.5: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he this by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
texts.gal.3.6: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
texts.gal.3.7: Know ye therefore, that they who are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
texts.gal.3.8: And the scripture foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel to Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
texts.gal.3.9: So then they who are of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
texts.gal.3.10: For as many as are of the works of the law, are under the curse: for it is written, Accursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
texts.gal.3.11: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
texts.gal.3.12: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live by them.
texts.gal.3.13: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Accursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
texts.gal.3.14: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
texts.gal.3.15: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it is but a man's covenant, yet if it is confirmed, no man disannulleth or addeth to it.
texts.gal.3.16: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
texts.gal.3.17: And this I say, that the covenant that was confirmed before by God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of no effect.
texts.gal.3.18: For if the inheritance is by the law, it is no more by promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
texts.gal.3.19: What purpose then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
texts.gal.3.20: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one; but God is one.
texts.gal.3.21: Is the law then against the promises of God? By no means: for if there had been a law given which could give life, verily righteousness would have been by the law.
texts.gal.3.22: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
texts.gal.3.23: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up to the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
texts.gal.3.24: Wherefore the law was our school-master to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
texts.gal.3.25: But after faith is come, we are no longer under a school-master.
texts.gal.3.26: For ye are all children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
texts.gal.3.27: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ, have put on Christ.
texts.gal.3.28: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
texts.gal.3.29: And if ye are Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
texts.gal.4.1: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he is lord of all;
texts.gal.4.2: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed by the father.
texts.gal.4.3: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
texts.gal.4.4: But when the fullness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
texts.gal.4.5: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
texts.gal.4.6: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
texts.gal.4.7: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
texts.gal.4.8: However then, when ye knew not God, ye did service to them which by nature are no gods.
texts.gal.4.9: But now, after ye have known God, or rather are known by God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, to which ye desire again to be in bondage?
texts.gal.4.10: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
texts.gal.4.11: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labor in vain.
texts.gal.4.12: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
texts.gal.4.13: Ye know that in infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel to you at the first.
texts.gal.4.14: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
texts.gal.4.15: What then was the blessedness ye spoke of; for I bear you testimony, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
texts.gal.4.16: Am I therefore become your enemy because I tell you the truth?
texts.gal.4.17: They zealously affect you, but not well; for, they would exclude you, that ye may affect them.
texts.gal.4.18: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
texts.gal.4.19: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again, until Christ be formed in you,
texts.gal.4.20: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
texts.gal.4.21: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
texts.gal.4.22: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons; the one by a bond-maid, the other by a free-woman.
texts.gal.4.23: But he who was of the bond-woman, was born according to the flesh; but he of the free-woman was by promise.
texts.gal.4.24: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
texts.gal.4.25: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
texts.gal.4.26: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
texts.gal.4.27: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she who hath a husband.
texts.gal.4.28: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
texts.gal.4.29: But as then he that was born according to the flesh persecuted him that was born according to the Spirit, even so it is now.
texts.gal.4.30: Nevertheless, what saith the scripture? Cast out the bond-woman and her son: for the son of the bond-woman shall not be heir with the son of the free-woman.
texts.gal.4.31: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bond-woman, but of the free.
texts.gal.5.1: Stand fast therefore in the liberty with which Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
texts.gal.5.2: Behold, I Paul say to you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ will profit you nothing.
texts.gal.5.3: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
texts.gal.5.4: Christ is become of no effect to you, whoever of you are justified by the law; ye have fallen from grace.
texts.gal.5.5: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
texts.gal.5.6: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
texts.gal.5.7: Ye did run well, who hindered you that ye should not obey the truth?
texts.gal.5.8: This persuasion cometh not from him that calleth you.
texts.gal.5.9: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
texts.gal.5.10: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be no otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whoever he may be.
texts.gal.5.11: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then hath the offense of the cross ceased.
texts.gal.5.12: I would they were even cut off who trouble you.
texts.gal.5.13: For, brethren, ye have been called to liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
texts.gal.5.14: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
texts.gal.5.15: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one by another.
texts.gal.5.16: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye will not fulfill the lust of the flesh.
texts.gal.5.17: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other; so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
texts.gal.5.18: But if ye are led by the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
texts.gal.5.19: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these, Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
texts.gal.5.20: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
texts.gal.5.21: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revelings, and such like: of which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they who do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
texts.gal.5.22: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, long-suffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
texts.gal.5.23: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
texts.gal.5.24: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh, with the affections and lusts.
texts.gal.5.25: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
texts.gal.5.26: Let us not be desirous of vain-glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
texts.gal.6.1: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye who are spiritual, restore such one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
texts.gal.6.2: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
texts.gal.6.3: For if a man thinketh himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
texts.gal.6.4: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
texts.gal.6.5: For every man shall bear his own burden.
texts.gal.6.6: Let him that is taught in the word communicate to him that teacheth in all good things.
texts.gal.6.7: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
texts.gal.6.8: For he that soweth to his flesh shall from the flesh reap corruption: but he that soweth to the Spirit, shall from the Spirit reap life everlasting.
texts.gal.6.9: And let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
texts.gal.6.10: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good to all men, especially to them who are of the household of faith.
texts.gal.6.11: Ye see how large a letter I have written to you with my own hand.
texts.gal.6.12: As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
texts.gal.6.13: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
texts.gal.6.14: But may it never be that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified to me, and I to the world.
texts.gal.6.15: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
texts.gal.6.16: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
texts.gal.6.17: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
texts.gal.6.18: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

texts.gal.1.1: Paul, apostle, not from men nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God [the] Father who raised him from among [the] dead,
texts.gal.1.2: and all the brethren with me, to the assemblies of Galatia.
texts.gal.1.3: Grace to you, and peace, from God [the] Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
texts.gal.1.4: who gave himself for our sins, so that he should deliver us out of the present evil world, according to the will of our God and Father;
texts.gal.1.5: to whom [be] glory to the ages of ages. Amen.
texts.gal.1.6: I wonder that ye thus quickly change, from him that called you in Christ's grace, to a different gospel,
texts.gal.1.7: which is not another [one]; but there are some that trouble you, and desire to pervert the glad tidings of the Christ.
texts.gal.1.8: But if even *we* or an angel out of heaven announce as glad tidings to you [anything] besides what we have announced as glad tidings to you, let him be accursed.
texts.gal.1.9: As we have said before, now also again I say, If any one announce to you as glad tidings [anything] besides what ye have received, let him be accursed.
texts.gal.1.10: For do I now seek to satisfy men or God? or do I seek to please men? If I were yet pleasing men, I were not Christ's bondman.
texts.gal.1.11: But I let you know, brethren, [as to] the glad tidings which were announced by me, that they are not according to man.
texts.gal.1.12: For neither did I receive them from man, neither was I taught [them], but by revelation of Jesus Christ.
texts.gal.1.13: For ye have heard [what was] my conversation formerly in Judaism, that I excessively persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it;
texts.gal.1.14: and advanced in Judaism beyond many [my] contemporaries in my nation, being exceedingly zealous of the doctrines of my fathers.
texts.gal.1.15: But when God, who set me apart [even] from my mother's womb, and called [me] by his grace,
texts.gal.1.16: was pleased to reveal his Son in me, that I may announce him as glad tidings among the nations, immediately I took not counsel with flesh and blood,
texts.gal.1.17: nor went I up to Jerusalem to those [who were] apostles before me; but I went to Arabia, and again returned to Damascus.
texts.gal.1.18: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to make acquaintance with Peter, and I remained with him fifteen days;
texts.gal.1.19: but I saw none other of the apostles, but James the brother of the Lord.
texts.gal.1.20: Now what I write to you, behold, before God, I do not lie.
texts.gal.1.21: Then I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
texts.gal.1.22: But I was unknown personally to the assemblies of Judaea which [are] in Christ;
texts.gal.1.23: only they were hearing that he who persecuted us formerly now announces the glad tidings of the faith which formerly he ravaged:
texts.gal.1.24: and they glorified God in me.
texts.gal.2.1: Then after a lapse of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with [me];
texts.gal.2.2: and I went up according to revelation, and I laid before them the glad tidings which I preach among the nations, but privately to those conspicuous [among them], lest in any way I run or had run in vain;
texts.gal.2.3: (but neither was Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, compelled to be circumcised;)
texts.gal.2.4: and [it was] on account of the false brethren brought in surreptitiously, who came in surreptitiously to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;
texts.gal.2.5: to whom we yielded in subjection not even for an hour, that the truth of the glad tidings might remain with you.
texts.gal.2.6: But from those who were conspicuous as being somewhat -- whatsoever they were, it makes no difference to me: God does not accept man's person; for to me those who were conspicuous communicated nothing;
texts.gal.2.7: but, on the contrary, seeing that the glad tidings of the uncircumcision were confided to me, even as to Peter that of the circumcision,
texts.gal.2.8: (for he that wrought in Peter for [the] apostleship of the circumcision wrought also in me towards the Gentiles,)
texts.gal.2.9: and recognising the grace given to me, James and Cephas and John, who were conspicuous as being pillars, gave to me and Barnabas [the] right hands of fellowship, that *we* [should go] to the nations, and *they* to the circumcision;
texts.gal.2.10: only that we should remember the poor, which same thing also I was diligent to do.
texts.gal.2.11: But when Peter came to Antioch, I withstood him to [the] face, because he was to be condemned:
texts.gal.2.12: for before that certain came from James, he ate with [those of] the nations; but when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those of [the] circumcision;
texts.gal.2.13: and the rest of the Jews also played the same dissembling part with him; so that even Barnabas was carried away too by their dissimulation.
texts.gal.2.14: But when I saw that they do not walk straightforwardly, according to the truth of the glad tidings, I said to Peter before all, If *thou*, being a Jew, livest as the nations and not as the Jews, how dost thou compel the nations to Judaize?
texts.gal.2.15: We, Jews by nature, and not sinners of [the] nations,
texts.gal.2.16: but knowing that a man is not justified on the principle of works of law [nor] but by the faith of Jesus Christ, *we* also have believed on Christ Jesus, that we might be justified on the principle of [the] faith of Christ; and not of works of law; because on the principle of works of law no flesh shall be justified.
texts.gal.2.17: Now if in seeking to be justified in Christ we also have been found sinners, then [is] Christ minister of sin? Far be the thought.
texts.gal.2.18: For if the things I have thrown down, these I build again, I constitute myself a transgressor.
texts.gal.2.19: For *I*, through law, have died to law, that I may live to God.
texts.gal.2.20: I am crucified with Christ, and no longer live, *I*, but Christ lives in me; but [in] that I now live in flesh, I live by faith, the [faith] of the Son of God, who has loved me and given himself for me.
texts.gal.2.21: I do not set aside the grace of God; for if righteousness [is] by law, then Christ has died for nothing.
texts.gal.3.1: O senseless Galatians, who has bewitched you; to whom, as before your very eyes, Jesus Christ has been portrayed, crucified [among you]?
texts.gal.3.2: This only I wish to learn of you, Have ye received the Spirit on the principle of works of law, or of [the] report of faith?
texts.gal.3.3: Are ye so senseless? having begun in Spirit, are ye going to be made perfect in flesh?
texts.gal.3.4: Have ye suffered so many things in vain, if indeed also in vain?
texts.gal.3.5: He therefore who ministers to you the Spirit, and works miracles among you, [is it] on the principle of works of law, or of [the] report of faith?
texts.gal.3.6: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned to him as righteousness.
texts.gal.3.7: Know then that they that are on the principle of faith, these are Abraham's sons;
texts.gal.3.8: and the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the nations on the principle of faith, announced beforehand the glad tidings to Abraham: In thee all the nations shall be blessed.
texts.gal.3.9: So that they who are on the principle of faith are blessed with believing Abraham.
texts.gal.3.10: For as many as are on the principle of works of law are under curse. For it is written, Cursed is every one who does not continue in all things which [are] written in the book of the law to do them;
texts.gal.3.11: but that by law no one is justified with God [is] evident, because The just shall live on the principle of faith;
texts.gal.3.12: but the law is not on the principle of faith; but, He that shall have done these things shall live by them.
texts.gal.3.13: Christ has redeemed us out of the curse of the law, having become a curse for us, (for it is written, Cursed [is] every one hanged upon a tree,)
texts.gal.3.14: that the blessing of Abraham might come to the nations in Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
texts.gal.3.15: Brethren, (I speak according to man,) even man's confirmed covenant no one sets aside, or adds other dispositions to.
texts.gal.3.16: But to Abraham were the promises addressed, and to his seed: he does not say, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed; which is Christ.
texts.gal.3.17: Now I say this, A covenant confirmed beforehand by God, the law, which took place four hundred and thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
texts.gal.3.18: For if the inheritance [be] on the principle of law, [it is] no longer on the principle of promise; but God gave it in grace to Abraham by promise.
texts.gal.3.19: Why then the law? It was added for the sake of transgressions, until the seed came to whom the promise was made, ordained through angels in [the] hand of a mediator.
texts.gal.3.20: But a mediator is not of one, but God is one.
texts.gal.3.21: [Is] then the law against the promises of God? Far be the thought. For if a law had been given able to quicken, then indeed righteousness were on the principle of law;
texts.gal.3.22: but the scripture has shut up all things under sin, that the promise, on the principle of faith of Jesus Christ, should be given to those that believe.
texts.gal.3.23: But before faith came, we were guarded under law, shut up to faith [which was] about to be revealed.
texts.gal.3.24: So that the law has been our tutor up to Christ, that we might be justified on the principle of faith.
texts.gal.3.25: But, faith having come, we are no longer under a tutor;
texts.gal.3.26: for ye are all God's sons by faith in Christ Jesus.
texts.gal.3.27: For ye, as many as have been baptised unto Christ, have put on Christ.
texts.gal.3.28: There is no Jew nor Greek; there is no bondman nor freeman; there is no male and female; for ye are all one in Christ Jesus:
texts.gal.3.29: but if *ye* [are] of Christ, then ye are Abraham's seed, heirs according to promise.
texts.gal.4.1: Now I say, As long as the heir is a child, he differs nothing from a bondman, though he be lord of all;
texts.gal.4.2: but he is under guardians and stewards until the period fixed by the father.
texts.gal.4.3: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the principles of the world;
texts.gal.4.4: but when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, come of woman, come under law,
texts.gal.4.5: that he might redeem those under law, that we might receive sonship.
texts.gal.4.6: But because ye are sons, God has sent out the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
texts.gal.4.7: So thou art no longer bondman, but son; but if son, heir also through God.
texts.gal.4.8: But then indeed, not knowing God, ye were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods;
texts.gal.4.9: but now, knowing God, but rather being known by God, how do ye turn again to the weak and beggarly principles to which ye desire to be again anew in bondage?
texts.gal.4.10: Ye observe days and months and times and years.
texts.gal.4.11: I am afraid of you, lest indeed I have laboured in vain as to you.
texts.gal.4.12: Be as *I* [am], for *I* also [am] as *ye*, brethren, I beseech you: ye have not at all wronged me.
texts.gal.4.13: But ye know that in weakness of the flesh I announced the glad tidings to you at the first;
texts.gal.4.14: and my temptation, which [was] in my flesh, ye did not slight nor reject with contempt; but ye received me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus.
texts.gal.4.15: What then [was] your blessedness? for I bear you witness that, if possible, plucking out your own eyes ye would have given [them] to me.
texts.gal.4.16: So I have become your enemy in speaking the truth to you?
texts.gal.4.17: They are not rightly zealous after you, but desire to shut you out [from us], that ye may be zealous after them.
texts.gal.4.18: But [it is] right to be zealous at all times in what is right, and not only when I am present with you --
texts.gal.4.19: my children, of whom I again travail in birth until Christ shall have been formed in you:
texts.gal.4.20: and I should wish to be present with you now, and change my voice, for I am perplexed as to you.
texts.gal.4.21: Tell me, ye who are desirous of being under law, do ye not listen to the law?
texts.gal.4.22: For it is written that Abraham had two sons; one of the maid servant, and one of the free woman.
texts.gal.4.23: But he [that was] of the maid servant was born according to flesh, and he [that was] of the free woman through the promise.
texts.gal.4.24: Which things have an allegorical sense; for these are two covenants: one from mount Sinai, gendering to bondage, which is Hagar.
texts.gal.4.25: For Hagar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and corresponds to Jerusalem which [is] now, for she is in bondage with her children;
texts.gal.4.26: but the Jerusalem above is free, which is our mother.
texts.gal.4.27: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break out and cry, thou that travailest not; because the children of the desolate are more numerous than [those] of her that has a husband.
texts.gal.4.28: But *ye*, brethren, after the pattern of Isaac, are children of promise.
texts.gal.4.29: But as then he that was born according to flesh persecuted him [that was born] according to Spirit, so also [it is] now.
texts.gal.4.30: But what says the scripture? Cast out the maid servant and her son; for the son of the maid servant shall not inherit with the son of the free woman.
texts.gal.4.31: So then, brethren, we are not maid servant's children, but [children] of the free woman.
texts.gal.5.1: Christ has set us free in freedom; stand fast therefore, and be not held again in a yoke of bondage.
texts.gal.5.2: Behold, I, Paul, say to you, that if ye are circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
texts.gal.5.3: And I witness again to every man [who is] circumcised, that he is debtor to do the whole law.
texts.gal.5.4: Ye are deprived of all profit from the Christ as separated [from him], as many as are justified by law; ye have fallen from grace.
texts.gal.5.5: For we, by [the] Spirit, on the principle of faith, await the hope of righteousness.
texts.gal.5.6: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision has any force, nor uncircumcision; but faith working through love.
texts.gal.5.7: Ye ran well; who has stopped you that ye should not obey the truth?
texts.gal.5.8: The persuasibleness [is] not of him that calls you.
texts.gal.5.9: A little leaven leavens the whole lump.
texts.gal.5.10: *I* have confidence as to you in [the] Lord, that ye will have no other mind; and he that is troubling you shall bear the guilt [of it], whosoever he may be.
texts.gal.5.11: But *I*, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why am I yet persecuted? Then the scandal of the cross has been done away.
texts.gal.5.12: I would that they would even cut themselves off who throw you into confusion.
texts.gal.5.13: For *ye* have been called to liberty, brethren; only [do] not [turn] liberty into an opportunity to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
texts.gal.5.14: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself;
texts.gal.5.15: but if ye bite and devour one another, see that ye are not consumed one of another.
texts.gal.5.16: But I say, Walk in [the] Spirit, and ye shall no way fulfil flesh's lust.
texts.gal.5.17: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these things are opposed one to the other, that ye should not do those things which ye desire;
texts.gal.5.18: but if ye are led by the Spirit, ye are not under law.
texts.gal.5.19: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are fornication, uncleanness, licentiousness,
texts.gal.5.20: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strifes, jealousies, angers, contentions, disputes, schools of opinion,
texts.gal.5.21: envyings, murders, drunkennesses, revels, and things like these; as to which I tell you beforehand, even as I also have said before, that they who do such things shall not inherit God's kingdom.
texts.gal.5.22: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, long-suffering, kindness, goodness, fidelity,
texts.gal.5.23: meekness, self-control: against such things there is no law.
texts.gal.5.24: But they that [are] of the Christ have crucified the flesh with the passions and the lusts.
texts.gal.5.25: If we live by the Spirit, let us walk also by the Spirit.
texts.gal.5.26: Let us not become vain-glorious, provoking one another, envying one another.
texts.gal.6.1: Brethren, if even a man be taken in some fault, ye who are spiritual restore such a one in a spirit of meekness, considering thyself lest *thou* also be tempted.
texts.gal.6.2: Bear one another's burdens, and thus fulfil the law of the Christ.
texts.gal.6.3: For if any man reputes himself to be something, being nothing, he deceives himself;
texts.gal.6.4: but let each prove his own work, and then he will have his boast in what belongs to himself alone, and not in what belongs to another.
texts.gal.6.5: For each shall bear his own burden.
texts.gal.6.6: Let him that is taught in the word communicate to him that teaches in all good things.
texts.gal.6.7: Be not deceived: God is not mocked; for whatever a man shall sow, that also shall he reap.
texts.gal.6.8: For he that sows to his own flesh, shall reap corruption from the flesh; but he that sows to the Spirit, from the Spirit shall reap eternal life:
texts.gal.6.9: but let us not lose heart in doing good; for in due time, if we do not faint, we shall reap.
texts.gal.6.10: So then, as we have occasion, let us do good towards all, and specially towards those of the household of faith.
texts.gal.6.11: See how long a letter I have written to you with my own hand.
texts.gal.6.12: As many as desire to have a fair appearance in [the] flesh, these compel you to be circumcised, only that they may not be persecuted because of the cross of Christ.
texts.gal.6.13: For neither do they that are circumcised themselves keep the law; but they wish you to be circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.
texts.gal.6.14: But far be it from me to boast save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom [the] world is crucified to me, and I to the world.
texts.gal.6.15: For [in Christ Jesus] neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision; but new creation.
texts.gal.6.16: And as many as shall walk by this rule, peace upon them and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
texts.gal.6.17: For the rest let no one trouble me, for *I* bear in my body the brands of the Lord Jesus.
texts.gal.6.18: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your spirit, brethren. Amen.

texts.gal.1.1: Paul, an apostle -- not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who did raise him out of the dead --
texts.gal.1.2: and all the brethren with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
texts.gal.1.3: Grace to you, and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
texts.gal.1.4: who did give himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of the present evil age, according to the will of God even our Father,
texts.gal.1.5: to whom [is] the glory to the ages of the ages. Amen.
texts.gal.1.6: I wonder that ye are so quickly removed from Him who did call you in the grace of Christ to another good news;
texts.gal.1.7: that is not another, except there be certain who are troubling you, and wishing to pervert the good news of the Christ;
texts.gal.1.8: but even if we or a messenger out of heaven may proclaim good news to you different from what we did proclaim to you -- anathema let him be!
texts.gal.1.9: as we have said before, and now say again, If any one to you may proclaim good news different from what ye did receive -- anathema let him be!
texts.gal.1.10: for now men do I persuade, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if yet men I did please -- Christ's servant I should not be.
texts.gal.1.11: And I make known to you, brethren, the good news that were proclaimed by me, that it is not according to man,
texts.gal.1.12: for neither did I from man receive it, nor was I taught [it], but through a revelation of Jesus Christ,
texts.gal.1.13: for ye did hear of my behaviour once in Judaism, that exceedingly I was persecuting the assembly of God, and wasting it,
texts.gal.1.14: and I was advancing in Judaism above many equals in age in mine own race, being more abundantly zealous of my fathers' deliverances,
texts.gal.1.15: and when God was well pleased -- having separated me from the womb of my mother, and having called [me] through His grace --
texts.gal.1.16: to reveal His Son in me, that I might proclaim him good news among the nations, immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood,
texts.gal.1.17: nor did I go up to Jerusalem unto those who were apostles before me, but I went away to Arabia, and again returned to Damascus,
texts.gal.1.18: then, after three years I went up to Jerusalem to enquire about Peter, and remained with him fifteen days,
texts.gal.1.19: and other of the apostles I did not see, except James, the brother of the Lord.
texts.gal.1.20: And the things that I write to you, lo, before God -- I lie not;
texts.gal.1.21: then I came to the regions of Syria and of Cilicia,
texts.gal.1.22: and was unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea, that [are] in Christ,
texts.gal.1.23: and only they were hearing, that `he who is persecuting us then, doth now proclaim good news -- the faith that then he was wasting;'
texts.gal.1.24: and they were glorifying God in me.
texts.gal.2.1: Then, after fourteen years again I went up to Jerusalem with Barnabas, having taken with me also Titus;
texts.gal.2.2: and I went up by revelation, and did submit to them the good news that I preach among the nations, and privately to those esteemed, lest in vain I might run or did run;
texts.gal.2.3: but not even Titus, who [is] with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised --
texts.gal.2.4: and [that] because of the false brethren brought in unawares, who did come in privily to spy out our liberty that we have in Christ Jesus, that us they might bring under bondage,
texts.gal.2.5: to whom not even for an hour we gave place by subjection, that the truth of the good news might remain to you.
texts.gal.2.6: And from those who were esteemed to be something -- whatever they were then, it maketh no difference to me -- the face of man God accepteth not, for -- to me those esteemed did add nothing,
texts.gal.2.7: but, on the contrary, having seen that I have been entrusted with the good news of the uncircumcision, as Peter with [that] of the circumcision,
texts.gal.2.8: for He who did work with Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, did work also in me in regard to the nations,
texts.gal.2.9: and having known the grace that was given to me, James, and Cephas, and John, who were esteemed to be pillars, a right hand of fellowship they did give to me, and to Barnabas, that we to the nations, and they to the circumcision [may go],
texts.gal.2.10: only, of the poor that we should be mindful, which also I was diligent -- this very thing -- to do.
texts.gal.2.11: And when Peter came to Antioch, to the face I stood up against him, because he was blameworthy,
texts.gal.2.12: for before the coming of certain from James, with the nations he was eating, and when they came, he was withdrawing and separating himself, fearing those of the circumcision,
texts.gal.2.13: and dissemble with him also did the other Jews, so that also Barnabas was carried away by their dissimulation.
texts.gal.2.14: But when I saw that they are not walking uprightly to the truth of the good news, I said to Peter before all, `If thou, being a Jew, in the manner of the nations dost live, and not in the manner of the Jews, how the nations dost thou compel to Judaize?
texts.gal.2.15: we by nature Jews, and not sinners of the nations,
texts.gal.2.16: having known also that a man is not declared righteous by works of law, if not through the faith of Jesus Christ, also we in Christ Jesus did believe, that we might be declared righteous by the faith of Christ, and not by works of law, wherefore declared righteous by works of law shall be no flesh.'
texts.gal.2.17: And if, seeking to be declared righteous in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, [is] then Christ a ministrant of sin? let it not be!
texts.gal.2.18: for if the things I threw down, these again I build up, a transgressor I set myself forth;
texts.gal.2.19: for I through law, did die, that to God I may live;
texts.gal.2.20: with Christ I have been crucified, and live no more do I, and Christ doth live in me; and that which I now live in the flesh -- in the faith I live of the Son of God, who did love me and did give himself for me;
texts.gal.2.21: I do not make void the grace of God, for if righteousness [be] through law -- then Christ died in vain.
texts.gal.3.1: O thoughtless Galatians, who did bewitch you, not to obey the truth -- before whose eyes Jesus Christ was described before among you crucified?
texts.gal.3.2: this only do I wish to learn from you -- by works of law the Spirit did ye receive, or by the hearing of faith?
texts.gal.3.3: so thoughtless are ye! having begun in the Spirit, now in the flesh do ye end?
texts.gal.3.4: so many things did ye suffer in vain! if, indeed, even in vain.
texts.gal.3.5: He, therefore, who is supplying to you the Spirit, and working mighty acts among you -- by works of law or by the hearing of faith [is it]?
texts.gal.3.6: according as Abraham did believe God, and it was reckoned to him -- to righteousness;
texts.gal.3.7: know ye, then, that those of faith -- these are sons of Abraham,
texts.gal.3.8: and the Writing having foreseen that by faith God doth declare righteous the nations did proclaim before the good news to Abraham --
texts.gal.3.9: `Blessed in thee shall be all the nations;' so that those of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham,
texts.gal.3.10: for as many as are of works of law are under a curse, for it hath been written, `Cursed [is] every one who is not remaining in all things that have been written in the Book of the Law -- to do them,'
texts.gal.3.11: and that in law no one is declared righteous with God, is evident, because `The righteous by faith shall live;'
texts.gal.3.12: and the law is not by faith, but -- `The man who did them shall live in them.'
texts.gal.3.13: Christ did redeem us from the curse of the law, having become for us a curse, for it hath been written, `Cursed is every one who is hanging on a tree,'
texts.gal.3.14: that to the nations the blessing of Abraham may come in Christ Jesus, that the promise of the Spirit we may receive through the faith.
texts.gal.3.15: Brethren, as a man I say [it], even of man a confirmed covenant no one doth make void or doth add to,
texts.gal.3.16: and to Abraham were the promises spoken, and to his seed; He doth not say, `And to seeds,' as of many, but as of one, `And to thy seed,' which is Christ;
texts.gal.3.17: and this I say, A covenant confirmed before by God to Christ, the law, that came four hundred and thirty years after, doth not set aside, to make void the promise,
texts.gal.3.18: for if by law [be] the inheritance, [it is] no more by promise, but to Abraham through promise did God grant [it].
texts.gal.3.19: Why, then, the law? on account of the transgressions it was added, till the seed might come to which the promise hath been made, having been set in order through messengers in the hand of a mediator --
texts.gal.3.20: and the mediator is not of one, and God is one --
texts.gal.3.21: the law, then, [is] against the promises of God? -- let it not be! for if a law was given that was able to make alive, truly by law there would have been the righteousness,
texts.gal.3.22: but the Writing did shut up the whole under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ may be given to those believing.
texts.gal.3.23: And before the coming of the faith, under law we were being kept, shut up to the faith about to be revealed,
texts.gal.3.24: so that the law became our child-conductor -- to Christ, that by faith we may be declared righteous,
texts.gal.3.25: and the faith having come, no more under a child-conductor are we,
texts.gal.3.26: for ye are all sons of God through the faith in Christ Jesus,
texts.gal.3.27: for as many as to Christ were baptized did put on Christ;
texts.gal.3.28: there is not here Jew or Greek, there is not here servant nor freeman, there is not here male and female, for all ye are one in Christ Jesus;
texts.gal.3.29: and if ye [are] of Christ then of Abraham ye are seed, and according to promise -- heirs.
texts.gal.4.1: And I say, so long time as the heir is a babe, he differeth nothing from a servant -- being lord of all,
texts.gal.4.2: but is under tutors and stewards till the time appointed of the father,
texts.gal.4.3: so also we, when we were babes, under the elements of the world were in servitude,
texts.gal.4.4: and when the fulness of time did come, God sent forth His Son, come of a woman, come under law,
texts.gal.4.5: that those under law he may redeem, that the adoption of sons we may receive;
texts.gal.4.6: and because ye are sons, God did send forth the spirit of His Son into your hearts, crying, `Abba, Father!'
texts.gal.4.7: so that thou art no more a servant, but a son, and if a son, also an heir of God through Christ.
texts.gal.4.8: But then, indeed, not having known God, ye were in servitude to those not by nature gods,
texts.gal.4.9: and now, having known God -- and rather being known by God -- how turn ye again unto the weak and poor elements to which anew ye desire to be in servitude?
texts.gal.4.10: days ye observe, and months, and times, and years!
texts.gal.4.11: I am afraid of you, lest in vain I did labour toward you.
texts.gal.4.12: Become as I [am] -- because I also [am] as ye brethren, I beseech you; to me ye did no hurt,
texts.gal.4.13: and ye have known that through infirmity of the flesh I did proclaim good news to you at the first,
